Description: Identified a Private Key, which may compromise cryptographic security and sensitive data encryption.
Author: Teknium
Message:
fix(delegation): fork forced copies from complete output before the budget

With security.redact_secrets=false the parent copy was budget-trimmed first
and memory callbacks, subagent_stop hooks and the async_delegations row were
then force-redacted from that excerpt. A head/tail cut that drops a PEM BEGIN
marker leaves a key body the text redactor no longer recognizes, so the full
private key body reached memory providers and SQLite event_json/result_json.

_finalize_child_results now projects the forced, structure-preserving copy
from the complete output before _apply_summary_budget, and the parent's
summary carries it (str subclass via parent_copy); redact_child_text/
redact_summary return it for every force=True sink. The forced excerpt and
the spill file are cut from that projection, and _spill_summary_to_file no
longer runs a second whole-text redact_for_egress, which corrupted valid
JSON answers on disk.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Teknium
Message:
fix(compression): fallback summaries, multiline setup notes and parallel loads keep skill markers right

Independent review follow-up:

- The deterministic fallback summary re-summarizes Phase-1 stubs, and
  _sum_skill_view re-decided the marker from the stub text, so a failed view's
  stub gained a reload marker there. A stub now keeps its own verdict (marker
  only if it already carries one), and a failed stub keeps FAILED.
- The auto-load describer ended a setup note at its first newline, so a
  multiline setup hint leaked into the recovered request. The note now ends
  at "]" followed by the blank line that separates generated blocks.
- _collect_ghosted_skill_names mapped every parallel skill_view call on one
  assistant row to the row's last skill, so two raw loads listed only one. It
  now uses the per-call mapping the lean-tail demotion already had.
- Fallback "User asked" anchors render a /skill turn as typed, like the other
  summary sections.

fix(compression): fallback summaries, multiline setup notes and parallel loads keep skill markers right

Independent review follow-up:

- The deterministic fallback summary re-summarizes Phase-1 stubs, and
  _sum_skill_view re-decided the marker from the stub text, so a failed view's
  stub gained a reload marker there. A stub now keeps its own verdict (marker
  only if it already carries one), and a failed stub keeps FAILED.
- The auto-load describer ended a setup note at its first newline, so a
  multiline setup hint leaked into the recovered request. The note now ends
  at "]" followed by the blank line that separates generated blocks.
- _collect_ghosted_skill_names mapped every parallel skill_view call on one
  assistant row to the row's last skill, so two raw loads listed only one. It
  now uses the per-call mapping the lean-tail demotion already had.
- Fallback "User asked" anchors render a /skill turn as typed, like the other
  summary sections.

fix(compression): fallback summaries, multiline setup notes and parallel loads keep skill markers right

Independent review follow-up:

- The deterministic fallback summary re-summarizes Phase-1 stubs, and
  _sum_skill_view re-decided the marker from the stub text, so a failed view's
  stub gained a reload marker there. A stub now keeps its own verdict (marker
  only if it already carries one), and a failed stub keeps FAILED.
- The auto-load describer ended a setup note at its first newline, so a
  multiline setup hint leaked into the recovered request. The note now ends
  at "]" followed by the blank line that separates generated blocks.
- _collect_ghosted_skill_names mapped every parallel skill_view call on one
  assistant row to the row's last skill, so two raw loads listed only one. It
  now uses the per-call mapping the lean-tail demotion already had.
- Fallback "User asked" anchors render a /skill turn as typed, like the other
  summary sections.

fix(compression): fallback summaries, multiline setup notes and parallel loads keep skill markers right

Independent review follow-up:

- The deterministic fallback summary re-summarizes Phase-1 stubs, and
  _sum_skill_view re-decided the marker from the stub text, so a failed view's
  stub gained a reload marker there. A stub now keeps its own verdict (marker
  only if it already carries one), and a failed stub keeps FAILED.
- The auto-load describer ended a setup note at its first newline, so a
  multiline setup hint leaked into the recovered request. The note now ends
  at "]" followed by the blank line that separates generated blocks.
- _collect_ghosted_skill_names mapped every parallel skill_view call on one
  assistant row to the row's last skill, so two raw loads listed only one. It
  now uses the per-call mapping the lean-tail demotion already had.
- Fallback "User asked" anchors render a /skill turn as typed, like the other
  summary sections.
